title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics shortcuts + SLO toolkit helpers
author: Elena Park
description: Context: Oncall responders frequently jump between incident-bot prompts and SLO runbooks to triage SLO breaches. Motivation: reduce mean time to mitigation by surfacing compact diagnostic shortcuts and SLO-toolkit helpers directly in notifications and the incident-bot interactive flow. What this PR does: 1) Adds a new lightweight 'diagnostic shortcuts' payload that bundles top-k relevant runbook links, quick checks (K8s p50/p95 latency query, recent deploys, replica counts) and a one-click open link for the SLO dashboard. 2) Extends slo-toolkit helpers with a compact scoring function used for ranking runbook relevance and a small caching layer to avoid repeated Linear/Jira lookups during a single oncall shift. 3) Adds CLI/HTTP flags to incident-bot to opt-in to the compact runbook format to preserve notification size for paging channels. 4) Unit + integration tests and a short migration guide. Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged; new compact payload is opt-in via "compact_runbooks":true. Rollout plan: feature-gated behind incident-bot config flag; stage 1: internal SRE canaries, stage 2: gradual enablement for high-severity SLO alerts only. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked (ENG-4821) - [x] unit tests - [x] integration tests against staging SLO service - [x] docs and migration notes added - [x] reviewed and approved by SRE and runtime. Notes: This is intentionally conservative: ranking function uses only metadata (SLO tags, recent change age, severity) to avoid noisy ML models in the alert path. See inline comments for perf rationale and small optimization decisions.
